about: David S. Willig serves as the international, multilingual attorney, notary and mediator heading David S. Willig, Chartered, in Miami, Florida. He focuses on international business litigation, corporate transactions, estate planning, intellectual property and alternative dispute resolution. His practice encompasses trade secrets, noncompete agreements, business formations, limited liability companies, partnership contracts and comprehensive business organizational matters. Additionally, he advises on copyrights, patents, trademarks and broader intellectual property concerns.

Mr. Willig has practiced law in Florida for over two decades and in France for more than 16 years. He is admitted to all federal courts in Florida, has appeared before various state courts and serves in the Paris Bar Association. He has led litigation in Lyon and frequently acts as an adept consultant or witness in cross-border disputes. He is fluent in English, French, Spanish and Portuguese, enabling seamless advocacy and consultation for clients whose native language is not English.

In Florida, Mr. Willig holds the title of civil-law notary, enabling him to notarize documents in jurisdictions following civil-law traditions, particularly in Europe and South America. Certified in 1999, this role complements his international practice and ensures precise legal documentation across languages and legal systems. In 2013, he further expanded his credentials by becoming a Certified Circuit Court Mediator for the Florida Supreme Court, offering tailored dispute-resolution services for a diverse clientele.

An academic scholar, Mr. Willig earned his Juris Doctor cum laude from the University of Miami School of Law in 1988. His subsequent admissions include The Florida Bar (1988), the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida (1989), District of Columbia Bar (1990), the United States Court of Appeals for the 7th (1999) 11th Circuits (1995), the Paris Bar Association (1997) and the United States District Courts for the Middle (2005) and Northern Districts of Florida (2012).

Scoring “Excellent” on Avvo, Mr. Willig is AV Preeminent* peer-review rated through Martindale-Hubbell. His unwavering commitment is to serve as an indispensable legal resource for clients whose endeavors traverse international borders.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
